name: Rectangular Pillow with Basket-Weave Décor
summary: Ceramic pillow of waisted quadrangular form, molded on four sides with a basket-weave pattern, the flat ends stamped with dotted star-like diaper pattern; pinkish buff earthenware with lead-fluxed amber-yellow glaze over molded decoration.
